 What We Build 

## Eight ways to makemore money on autopilot.

 Each one runs on its own once it is set up. Pick the ones that fit your business. Skip the ones that don't. 

## Cold outreach that lands

 200 to 500 personalised emails a month into qualified inboxes in your niche. Jitter built in to keep the sending IP clean. Replies come back, you book the call. 
 Most popular 

## Found on Google. Found on AI.

 Local SEO and the new GEO pass that gets you cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini. Schema, llms.txt, the lot. You appear where buyers actually look in 2026. 

## Google Business Profile, finished

 Photos, posts, Q&amp;A, weekly updates, review chasing. The profile most local businesses leave half-done is the one most buyers actually click. We finish yours. 

## A website that converts

 Fast, mobile-first, written for the person reading it. Live in 48 hours for service businesses, 2 weeks for full shops. Built to turn visitors into bookings, not awards. 

## eBay, Etsy, Amazon listings on autopilot

 Connect your account once. We push fully optimised listings with priced-to-market positioning, competitor-anchored copy, and proper item specifics. New SKU live in your store in minutes. 
 New 

## Email sequences that sell

 Welcome series, cart-recovery, post-purchase, lapsed-buyer. Written in your voice, not template-speak. The cold contacts warm up, the past clients buy again.

 We extract how you actually talk from your real work, calls, and reviews. Then every email, listing, post, and ad sounds like you wrote it on a good day. Even when we did. 

## Product photos and AI imagery

 Studio-style product shots from phone photos. Lifestyle scenes generated on brand. Spec graphics in your colour palette. The visual layer that pushes a £15 listing into a £25 listing.

# About Tk · Founder of Conversion Forge, Sevenoaks · Kent Marketing
URL: https://conversionforge.co.uk/about.html

About Tk · Founder of Conversion Forge, Sevenoaks · Kent Marketing 

 About 

## One person.Sevenoaks, Kent.

 Conversion Forge is not an agency floor. It is me, Tk, and a stack of systems I built so that a small business can get the same machinery a big one buys, without the monthly bill. 

 Who you are dealing with 

## There is no account manager.There is just me.

 Tk · Founder · Sevenoaks, Kent 

 My name is Tk. I was born in South Africa and I live in Sevenoaks. I left my job in pursuit of a way to be a more present father while still providing for my family, and to find the work life balance I actually wanted. The reward I get is giving small businesses prices they can afford at the level they are at right now. 

 I kept seeing the same thing. The word of mouth well tends to dry up, and the local business tends to miss out on making the most of its online reputation to get attention. So I set out to give small businesses the best way to contend with big businesses and even bigger budgets. Nothing I build is out of range, and you do not do it alone. 

 When you talk to Conversion Forge, you are talking to me. I answer the first message, I run the discovery call, I build the thing, and I am the one you shout at if it breaks. There is no team to hide behind and no junior learning on your money. 

 The work 

## Built once. Handed over.Yours to keep.

 Most agencies rent you a website. Stop paying, and it goes dark. I build the system, put your name on it, and give you the keys: the code, the accounts, the passwords, the lot. If you never speak to me again, everything I built keeps running. 

 The work itself is unglamorous and specific. Getting a business to show up on Google Maps when someone nearby is searching for it. Building a site that turns a visitor into a booking instead of an award. Rewriting an eBay listing so it actually gets found. Setting up the outreach that fills a quiet week. 

 I use a lot of automation to do it, which is why the prices are what they are. That is the honest reason. It is not magic and I am not going to dress it up as magic. 

 Who I have built for 

## Real businesses.Most of them down the road.

 A barber shop in Sevenoaks. A personal trainer. A car dealer. A Jamaican restaurant. A jewellery seller doing 240 product variations on eBay. These are not logos I bought the right to display. They are people whose sites I built and whose numbers I can show you, and several of them are a short walk from my front door. 

 The numbers on the results page come from the platforms that produced them, not from a spreadsheet I made up. If a figure cannot be traced back to Search Console, eBay Seller Hub, or Instagram Insights, it does not go on the page. 

 Some of the work did not go to plan, and where that happened I say so on the case study rather than quietly leaving it out. An agency that has never had a bad month is an agency that is lying to you. 

 How I work 

## Four things I will not move on.

 You own it. Every engagement ends with a handover folder. Source code, content, accounts, credentials. No hostage situations. 

 No retainer unless you want one. You pay for a thing, you get the thing. If you want me to keep improving it afterwards, that is a separate conversation and it is your choice, not a condition. 

 Every number is traceable. If I cannot show you where a figure came from, I will not use it. 

 I tell you when something will not work. Including when the thing you are asking me to sell you is the wrong thing to buy. I would rather lose the sale than build you something that quietly fails for a year. 

 Next step 

## Have a look at your own businessthe way Google sees it.

 The free audit is exactly what it says. I look at what a customer finds when they search for a business like yours, and I tell you where you are losing the job. There is no obligation and no sales sequence waiting on the other side of it. 

 If it turns out you do not need me, I will say that too. 

 Book a free call

# Methodology · How Conversion Forge Builds Marketing Systems · Sevenoaks, Kent
URL: https://conversionforge.co.uk/methodology.html

Methodology · How Conversion Forge Builds Marketing Systems · Sevenoaks, Kent 

 Methodology 

## Six engines.One system.

 How Conversion Forge ships systems instead of retainers. The architecture, the model stack, and the principle behind every deliverable being owned by the client. 

 The Architecture 

## Six engines, sequenced.

 Each engine is a distinct workflow. Specialisation means each ships fast and breaks less. Failure in one engine does not cascade to the others. 

 Engine 01 
 Intake and qualification 
 Onboarding form, discovery call, prospect-fit classification. Sorts in scope from out of scope before money changes hands. 

 Engine 02 
 Proposal generation 
 Three modes (priced-stages, discovery, tier-2 multi-phase). Brand-cohered, dual-emit markdown plus HTML, humanizer-checked. 

 Engine 03 
 Demo build 
 Cloudflare Pages site, brand-cohered theme, shared chassis components. Live URL the client can hand to a friend. 

 Engine 04 
 Lead and revenue rails 
 Stripe checkout, contact forms, callback widgets, automated outreach. The plumbing that turns visits into revenue. 

 Engine 05 
 SEO and AI visibility 
 Schema markup, llms.txt, structured data. Local pack ranking and citation across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity. 

 Engine 06 
 Handover and ownership 
 Branded PDF recap, OneDrive folder, every credential and source file. The client owns it from day one. 

 How the work is made 

## The best mind for the job.Then a second to check it.

 Most of what calls itself AI is a single model doing everything. That is the quick way, and it shows in the work. We do the slower, more deliberate thing. Every part of your project is given to the system best suited to it, and the parts that matter are checked by a separate one that played no part in making them. More passes, more scrutiny, and a result that holds up when it counts. 

 The right intelligence for each task 
 Planning, writing, building and reviewing each call for a different kind of thinking. Every step of your work is matched to the system best suited to it, rather than forced through one tool that is only ever passable at all of them. 

 A second opinion on everything that matters 
 Important work is checked by a separate, independent system that had no part in making it. One mind can be confidently wrong. Two rarely make the same mistake. By the time the work reaches you, it has already been challenged. 

 It keeps running when one part fails 
 The method never leans on a single supplier. If one is busy or unavailable, the work carries on and you never see the difference. Your pipeline does not have an off switch. 

 One standard, every time 
 Whichever part of the system does the work, the bar is the same. You get the considered version, planned, drafted and checked, not the first thing a machine happened to return. 

 Questions clients ask 

## Before you book.

 Why does Conversion Forge use six engines instead of one? 
 Each engine is a distinct workflow with its own LLM model, its own data sources, and its own success criteria. Lead generation runs on a different rhythm than payment integration, which runs differently from SEO. Specialising the engines means each one ships faster and breaks less than a single monolithic system would. Failure in one engine does not cascade to the others. 

 What powers the systems? 
 More than one system, and never only one. Different work calls for different strengths, so each task is given to the approach best suited to it, and the parts that matter are checked by a separate, independent one. We are not tied to any single provider, which is also why the work keeps running if one of them has a bad day. 

 Do clients own what we build? 
 Yes. Every engagement closes with a handover bundle: source code, content, accounts, and credentials, in a folder the client owns. The agency retains internal operating systems, but the client never has to come back to us to make a change. If we ever stop trading, the client keeps running. 

 What does the 48-hour build claim actually mean? 
 It means the core lead-generation system (Google Business Profile, contact form, basic site, first outreach sequence) is configured and live within 48 working hours of the initial discovery call. It does not mean every long-term growth lever is in place. Those layer in over weeks two through six. 

 How do you measure success? 
 Platform-verifiable numbers only. Impressions and conversion rates come from Google Search Console, eBay Seller Hub, Instagram Insights, or the client's own analytics. The case study page publishes screenshots, not estimates. If a number cannot be sourced from the platform that generated it, it does not get used. 

 Why niche-locked to UK small businesses? 
 Until 30 documented case studies are filed, every engagement is a UK small business. Tradesmen, restaurants, beauty practitioners, eCommerce. Same playbook, same architecture, ten clients deep before broader expansion. Specialisation compounds; spreading does not. 

 Your Business
